entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that can restrict access for certain groups of UEs by barring their access class.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE that shall evaluate access control information for various access control mechanisms.

entities.name: Access Class Barring
entities.description: Access control mechanism where the network bars access based on UE access classes.

entities.name: Access Control for CSFB and Extended Access Barring
entities.description: Access control mechanism for Circuit Switched Fallback and Extended Access Barring scenarios.

entities.name: Application specific Congestion control for Data Communication
entities.description: Access control mechanism for application-specific congestion control, evaluated if UE supports ACDC.

relations.description: Network can restrict access by implementing access class barring.
UE shall evaluate access control information for Access Class Barring.
UE shall evaluate access control information for CSFB and Extended Access Barring.
UE shall evaluate access control information for ACDC if supported.
